definition.simple: The company's profit divided by its number of shares: how much profit belongs to each share.
definition.balanced: EPS = net income ÷ shares outstanding. It lets you compare profit with the price of one share. If a company issues many new shares, EPS can fall even when total profit rises.

example: Net income 114 million USD ÷ 200 million shares = 0.57 USD per share.
